question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**crossed**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context implies that the speaker and Drummle encountered each other regularly.
 
• The verb should describe the act of coming into contact or encountering each other.
 
• "**Crossed**" fits well as it commonly describes paths intersecting or meeting.
 
• Other options ("**acrossed**", "**meet**", "**saw**") do not fit as naturally in this narrative context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.
